name: Cube Killer
author: Addicting Games
description: Cube Killer is a free mobile game. You are a pig-shaped war machine on a never-ending march to the heart of the empire. Your snout is a double-barrelled canon that belches out hot-leaded justice in the face of the big bad. Use your reflexes and heavy auto to mow down legions of enemies as they charge toward you, guns blazing. This is a game for the most fearless players out there. Those who wish to take on the empire do so at their own peril. When you play "Cube Killer" you are the last hero in a corrupt world.
